_comment: Snapshot of active Zoho Books items. Refreshed by build_catalog.py --refresh. Do not hand-edit prices here - edit them in Zoho Books.

items.name: Custom Keychain
items.description: Available in custom silhouettes, arch profiles, and layered circular frames, these laser-engraved wooden keychains turn personalized names, dates, and bespoke graphics into stylish, everyday keepsakes.

items.name: Customised Name Stand
items.description: Bold 3D lettering and precision-engraved personal text on a tiered display base. An elegant, bespoke accent for desks, workstations, and appreciation gifts.

items.name: FM Customised Bookmark
items.description: Crafted from laser-cut plywood with a satin ribbon tie, these custom bookmarks feature delicate engraved patterns alongside personalized names and heartfelt messages. A charming, functional keepsake for Teacher's Day and special appreciation gifts.

items.name: HG Mini Frame 8X10
items.description: A beautiful and compact 8x10 wooden photo frame featuring an easel back and hanging hooks. Perfect as a heartwarming, personalized Teacher's Day gift to display cherished classroom memories on a desk or wall.

items.name: Event Board
items.description: An elegant and beautifully crafted Mas Kahwin and Hantaran plaque, perfect for weddings and traditional dowry presentations.

items.name: Plaque - A4 Standard
items.description: Featuring layered laser-cut patterns and bold 3D script, this personalized wooden commemorative plaque showcases high-detail portrait engraving alongside custom dedications and wishes. Suitable for a timeless, heartfelt birthday or appreciation keepsake.

items.name: Plaque - A5 Budget
items.description: An affordable and elegant A5 budget plaque, perfect for corporate recognition and awards ceremonies.

items.name: Plaque - A5 Premium
items.description: Crafted from premium laminated plywood and clear acrylic, this appreciation plaque blends laser-cut geometric motifs with precision-engraved event details. A refined, modern keepsake for corporate gifts and official ceremonies.

items.name: Quran Cover - DQ
items.description: An elegant and beautifully crafted Quran cover, perfect as a premium wedding gift or keepsake.

items.name: Rehal
items.description: A handcarved wooden rehal designed to hold the Holy Quran at a comfortable reading angle, serving as both a functional prayer accessory and a traditional Islamic gift.
